text:
Alex: Quick readiness check — planning to enable canary for model v14 with a proportional drip. Initial scope: 3% EU, then 10% NA after 30m, then broader depending on signals. Toggle name: `canary_v14_proportional`. Anyone from infra / oncall able to ack? Any gating concerns (SLO regressions, quantized-run variance)?

Maya: SGTM. One ask: make sure KV-cache warmup for quantized profiles is enabled before we ramp. Also adding smoke queries set A now.

Jamal: Oncall here. I can monitor error budget + latency. What's the explicit rollback trigger? My suggestion: 2x baseline error rate OR >5% p95 latency regression sustained for 15m.

Sophia: I just ran a quick perf smoke against the v14 quantized build. Paste results shortly; tl;dr looks within acceptable variance (+1-3% token cost/latency).

Alex: Short rollout runbook I'm planning to follow:
```text
1) flip `canary_v14_proportional` -> 3% region=eu
2) monitor 20m: errors, p95 latency, traces, cost per token
3) if stable -> increase to 10% region=na
4) monitor 40m -> decide on broader ramp or pause
Rollback quick command: set percent=0 and revert routing to v13
```
I'll trigger step 1 in ~5m unless there are objections.

Maya: +1. Also enable trace sampling=100% for canary traffic for the first 60m so we have full traces.

Jamal: Subscribed to alerts and the canary channel. Pre-created PD runbook: https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/1234 (watch that if we see error spikes).

rollout-bot: Scheduled ramp job created: job_id=rb-198765-01, scheduled_by=Alex, created_at=1987654380, initial_percent=3, region=eu. Logs: https://ops.logs/streams/rb-198765-01

Sophia: smoke results: baseline -> v14: p95 240ms -> 255ms, errors 0.02% -> 0.03%. Noted KV-cache cold start slightly higher but warms within 2 requests. I'll attach the raw traces to the job.

Alex: OK starting now. I'll flip to 3% EU and watch. Ping @oncall if anything weird. :rocket:

Jamal: Confirmed. If thresholds hit I'll run rollback. Quick rollback command for reference:
```bash
/flags set canary_v14_proportional 0 --reason "automated rollback threshold" --runbook rb-198765-01
```

Alex: First stage complete — left at 3% EU. Next bump scheduled +30m (scheduled_at=1987656180). Will post updates after 20m check.

Maya: Thanks — I added the trace dashboard and a short alert for cache thrash so we can catch any degradation early.

Jamal: Standing by.
